description: Query Solana DEX data: prices, metadata, launches, graduations, live stream tails.
name: com.anaxer/mcp

environmentVariables.description: Anaxer API key (Bearer). Set in the MCP host config — never pass as a tool argument.
environmentVariables.name: ANAXER_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: REST API base URL. Defaults to https://api.anaxer.com (local gateway: http://localhost:3010).
environmentVariables.name: ANAXER_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: WebSocket URL override. Defaults to derived from ANAXER_BASE_URL → …/v1/stream.
environmentVariables.name: ANAXER_WS_URL

title: Anaxer
